vulnerable_areas_ne: बल्खु, सुकुम्बासी बस्ती, सुन्दरीघाट, टेकु, चोभार, कालिमाटी करिडोर, नदी किनारका होचा भूभागहरू
vulnerable_areas_en: Balkhu, informal squatter settlements (Sukumbasi basti), Sundarighat, Teku, Kalimati corridor, low-lying riverside communities
description: Critical confluence point in Kathmandu valley prone to severe flash flooding during heavy upstream rains in Shivapuri range.

vulnerable_areas_ne: गौरीघाट, गुह्येश्वरी, तिलगंगा, सिनामंगल, पशुपति तटीय क्षेत्र
vulnerable_areas_en: Gaurighat, Guhyeshwari, Tilganga, Sinamangal, Pashupati riverbanks
description: Upper Kathmandu river gauge monitoring water emerging from Gokarna and Sundarijal foothills.

vulnerable_areas_ne: सुन्दरीजल, नयाँ बस्ती, गोकर्णेश्वर, जोरपाटी, गौरीघाट
vulnerable_areas_en: Sundarijal, Naya Basti, Gokarneshwar, Jorpati riverside corridor
description: Primary headwater monitoring point directly below Shivapuri watershed.

vulnerable_areas_ne: चोभार गल्छी, नख्खु दोभान, बागमती तटीय क्षेत्र, दक्षिणकाली सडक किनार
vulnerable_areas_en: Chobhar gorge, Nakkhu confluence, lower Bagmati riverside, Dakshinkali road corridor
description: Valley bottleneck exit. When choked or overwhelmed, causes massive upstream backwater inundation across Balkhu and Teku.

vulnerable_areas_ne: नख्खुडोल, टीकाभैरव, बुङमती, सैंबु सुकुम्बासी टोल, नख्खु पुल आसपास बस्ती
vulnerable_areas_en: Nakkhudol, Tikabhairab, Bungamati, Saibu squatter settlements, Nakkhu bridge corridor
description: Steep mountainous sub-basin prone to intense flash floods. Swept away riverside settlements in September 2024.

station_name: Roshi Khola at Panauti / Bhakunde Besi
vulnerable_areas_ne: पनौती, भकुण्डेबेसी, रोशी गाउँपालिका, बिपी राजमार्ग तटीय क्षेत्र, मङ्गलटार
vulnerable_areas_en: Panauti, Bhakundebesi, Roshi rural municipality, BP Highway riverside settlements, Mangaltar
description: Site of catastrophic late September 2024 flash floods that destroyed the BP Highway and downstream communities.

vulnerable_areas_ne: चतरा, बराहक्षेत्र, प्रकाशपुर, कोशी टप्पु, मधुवन, राजावास, सुनसरी र सप्तरी तटीय क्षेत्र
vulnerable_areas_en: Chatara, Barahakshetra, Prakashpur, Koshi Tappu, Madhuwan, Sunsari-Saptari embankment zones
description: Major trans-Himalayan river gorge discharging into the Gangetic plains. Critical for eastern Nepal flood defense.

vulnerable_areas_ne: देवघाट, नारायणगढ, भरतपुर, गैंडाकोट, मेघौली, त्रिवेणी सुस्ता क्षेत्र
vulnerable_areas_en: Devghat, Narayangarh, Bharatpur riverside, Gaidakot, Meghauli, Susta downstream plains
description: Massive central river basin fed by Annapurna, Manaslu and Langtang catchments. High volume flood hazard.
